entry.title: Welcome to the SaiU FOSS Wiki
entry.summary: Welcome to the SaiU FOSS Wiki — the community-maintained living record of the FOSS Club at Sai University.
entry.content:
Welcome to the SaiU FOSS Wiki — the community-maintained living record of the FOSS Club at Sai University.

This wiki is where we document our events, share resources, and write about the things we're building. It's built with Docusaurus and hosted on GitHub Pages, which means anyone can contribute.

What You'll Find Here​

  • Event writeups — recaps and photos from workshops, mapping parties, and hack nights
  • Resources — curated FOSS tools, guides, and policy links
  • Projects — open source projects maintained by club members
  • Blog posts — updates, tutorials, and perspectives from club members

How to Contribute​

Fork the wiki repo, add your content, and open a pull request. Check the Contributing Guide for details.

We're excited to build this with you. Welcome aboard!
